description: EC2 instance not reported in independently complete Inspector2 coverage inventory
rationale: EC2 instance was observed, but its own-account identifier did not appear in a complete Inspector2 coverage listing in the same region. It may be ineligible, newly created or covered outside this observation; this is not proof that the instance is unscanned.
remediation: Verify Inspector2 EC2 enrollment, instance eligibility, scan account/region and current coverage; investigate unsupported or missing scan registrations.
